svg.title: promptly-mobile (Android companion)
svg.desc: Android companion app: a floating bubble records the microphone over any screen; Groq Whisper transcribes the recording, an optional LLM translation runs, and gpt-oss-20b polishes the text using the user's personal vocabulary before it is copied to the clipboard. Connection failures retry automatically; a surviving failure keeps the recording in an amber paused state (tap to retry, hold to discard). Configured from one settings screen and two Quick Settings tiles.

MainActivity (settings screen)
g.desc: Launcher activity and configuration screen: Groq API key, accurate-model switch, AI polish switch, personal vocabulary, language picker and optional translate-to picker. Its Start button walks the permission chain (overlay permission, notifications, microphone) and starts the overlay service.. Purpose: First-run setup and on/off switch for the floating bubble.. How it works: Every field saves live to the 'promptly' SharedPreferences while typing (no Save button). tryStartOverlay() requires an API key, Settings.canDrawOverlays (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW), POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+, then RECORD_AUDIO, launching the foreground service on success and setting overlay_visible=true. The Add tiles button only shows instructions for dragging the two Quick Settings tiles into place.. Inputs: user input: API key, switches, vocab, language, translate-to. Outputs: startForegroundService(OverlayService); stopService; SharedPreferences writes. Dependencies: OverlayService; SharedPreferences store. Evidence: MainActivity.kt: tryStartOverlay; MainActivity.kt: startOverlay; MainActivity.kt: prefs edit calls; AndroidManifest.xml: MainActivity LAUNCHER intent-filter. Chart: Source lines per Kotlin file. Independent categories; bars are not connected. g.title: OverlayService (bubble + brain)
g.desc: Foreground service (foregroundServiceType=microphone) that owns everything: the 38dp floating bubble window, the drag-to-close X target window, the IDLE / RECORDING / TRANSCRIBING / PAUSED state machine, retrying transcription, translation, polish and clipboard delivery. Keeps the user's recording file until transcription succeeds.. Purpose: Record and transcribe from anywhere, resilient to connection loss.. How it works: Bubble taps drive the state machine; a persistent low-priority notification mirrors the state. On stop, the m4a file becomes pendingFile and transcribeWithRetries() runs up to 3 attempts (2 s / 4 s delays, cancellable mid-flight). A surviving retryable failure enters PAUSED (amber bubble): tap retries, 600 ms hold or hiding the bubble or dropping it on the X discards. finishTranscription() then optionally translates (only when translate-to differs from the spoken language), polishes if enabled (refusal guard falls back to the raw text), and copies to the clipboard. START_STICKY keeps it alive; drag-to-close shows the X target only in IDLE and PAUSED, never while recording or transcribing.. Inputs: bubble tap/drag/hold gestures; tile intents (toggle overlay/recording); settings from SharedPreferences. Outputs: recorder start/stop; Groq HTTP calls; clipboard copy; toasts and notification updates; window add/remove for bubble and X target. Dependencies: Recorder; GroqApi HTTP client; SharedPreferences store; Android clipboard. Evidence: OverlayService.kt: transcribeWithRetries; OverlayService.kt: finishTranscription; OverlayService.kt: enterPaused / retryPending / discardPending; OverlayService.kt: handleTouch + trackCloseDrag; AndroidManifest.xml: OverlayService foregroundServiceType=microphone. Source: app/src/main/java/com/promptly/mobile/OverlayService.kt

g.title: Recorder
g.desc: Thin MediaRecorder wrapper: records the microphone to AAC audio in an MPEG_4 container, written to a timestamped promptly_*.m4a file in the app cache directory.. Purpose: Capture a recording that can be retried later — the file is kept until transcription succeeds.. How it works: start() creates MediaRecorder (context constructor on Android 12+), sets MIC source, MPEG_4 output, AAC encoder and the cache-dir output file. stop() stops and releases, returning the file. release() is a safe cleanup used on failure and service teardown.. Inputs: microphone audio. Outputs: m4a file in cacheDir. Dependencies: Microphone (MediaRecorder). Evidence: Recorder.kt: start; Recorder.kt: stop; Recorder.kt: File(context.cacheDir, "promptly_...m4a"). Source: app/src/main/java/com/promptly/mobile/Recorder.kt

g.title: Microphone (MediaRecorder)
g.desc: The device microphone, accessed through MediaRecorder with the RECORD_AUDIO permission and the service's microphone foreground-service type.. Purpose: Source of raw audio.. How it works: Guarded by a runtime permission check in OverlayService.startRecording; a missing permission sends the user back to MainActivity.. Outputs: AAC audio into the m4a file. Evidence: Recorder.kt: MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC; OverlayService.kt: checkSelfPermission(RECORD_AUDIO); AndroidManifest.xml: RECORD_AUDIO + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE

g.title: GroqApi HTTP client
g.desc: OkHttp-based module with the three Groq calls (transcribe, polish, translate) plus the shared helpers: retryability classification, refusal detection and the vocabulary spelling-hint builder — text mirrored from the desktop app's polisher.. Purpose: One place for every network call and the exact prompt engineering shared with desktop.. How it works: transcribe() posts multipart form to /openai/v1/audio/transcriptions with model, response_format=text, language and the optional vocabPrompt (capped at 700 chars). polish() posts the cleanup system prompt + vocabBlock with the transcript wrapped in <transcript> tags to chat/completions using openai/gpt-oss-20b, temperature 0, reasoning_effort low. translate() posts a translator prompt to chat/completions using llama-3.3-70b-versatile. isRetryable() treats UnknownHost/Connect/SocketTimeout/SSL exceptions and HTTP 429/5xx as transient. OkHttp timeouts: 10 s connect, 45 s read.. Inputs: m4a file; API key; model/language choices; vocab list; text to polish or translate. Outputs: OkHttp Call objects (executed by OverlayService); isRetryable / looksLikeRefusal verdicts; vocabPrompt string. Dependencies: Groq audio transcriptions API; Groq chat completions API. Evidence: GroqApi.kt: transcribe; GroqApi.kt: polish; GroqApi.kt: translate; GroqApi.kt: isRetryable; GroqApi.kt: POLISH_MODEL = "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Source: app/src/main/java/com/promptly/mobile/GroqApi.kt

g.title: Groq audio transcriptions API
g.desc: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions — Whisper (whisper-large-v3 when accurate_model is on, otherwise whisper-large-v3-turbo) with response_format text, the chosen language, and the optional vocabulary spelling hint.. Purpose: Cloud transcription backend.. How it works: Multipart POST with Bearer auth; the m4a recording is uploaded from the cache file. Non-2xx responses raise IOException('HTTP <code>: ...') which feeds the retry classifier.. Inputs: m4a upload; model, language, prompt; Groq API key. Outputs: transcript text. Evidence: GroqApi.kt: url "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions"; OverlayService.kt: model = if (accurate) whisper-large-v3 else whisper-large-v3-turbo

g.title: Groq chat completions API
g.desc: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions — runs the gpt-oss-20b text polish and, when a translate-to language is chosen, the llama-3.3-70b-versatile translation.. Purpose: Cloud cleanup and translation backend.. How it works: Two JSON POST shapes from the same endpoint: polish (temperature 0, reasoning_effort low, <transcript>-tagged user content) and translate (temperature 0.2, translator system prompt). Both parsed with org.json for choices[0].message.content.. Inputs: JSON chat request; Groq API key. Outputs: polished text / translated text. Evidence: GroqApi.kt: polish; GroqApi.kt: translate; OverlayService.kt: finishTranscription translate/polish blocks

g.title: Android clipboard
g.desc: The system ClipboardManager; the finished text is delivered here (the user then pastes it anywhere — this app does not inject input events).. Purpose: Delivery channel for the final text.. How it works: copyToClipboard sets ClipData.newPlainText('Promptly', text); toasts confirm 'Copied' or 'Translated & copied'.. Inputs: final text. Outputs: clipboard content. Evidence: OverlayService.kt: copyToClipboard; OverlayService.kt: toast messages

g.title: SharedPreferences ('promptly')
g.desc: One private preference file holding api_key, accurate_model, polish_text, custom_vocab, language, translate_to, overlay_visible and the recording flag that the tiles read.. Purpose: Shared configuration store across the activity, the service and both tiles.. How it works: MainActivity writes on every keystroke/selection; OverlayService reads key, model, language, vocab, polish and translate settings per run and maintains overlay_visible/recording flags; the tiles read those flags to draw their state.. Inputs: writes from MainActivity and OverlayService. Outputs: settings and state flags to all three readers. Evidence: MainActivity.kt: getSharedPreferences("promptly", MODE_PRIVATE); OverlayService.kt: PREFS = "promptly"; OverlayTileService.kt: prefs.getBoolean("overlay_visible", true); RecordTileService.kt: prefs.getBoolean("recording", false)

g.title: Overlay Quick Settings tile
g.desc: Quick Settings tile that shows/hides the floating bubble by sending ACTION_TOGGLE_OVERLAY to the foreground service; its active state mirrors the overlay_visible preference.. Purpose: Toggle the bubble without opening the app.. How it works: onClick() starts the OverlayService intent with the toggle action and refreshes the tile label/state from prefs.. Inputs: tile tap. Outputs: startForegroundService intent; tile state update. Dependencies: OverlayService; SharedPreferences store. Evidence: OverlayTileService.kt: onClick; OverlayTileService.kt: refresh; AndroidManifest.xml: BIND_QUICK_SETTINGS_TILE service declaration. Source: app/src/main/java/com/promptly/mobile/OverlayTileService.kt

g.title: Record Quick Settings tile
g.desc: Quick Settings tile that starts/stops a recording by sending ACTION_TOGGLE_RECORDING to the foreground service; its active state mirrors the recording preference flag.. Purpose: Remote control for recording, e.g. with the screen off.. How it works: onClick() sends the toggle-recording action (which the service maps to the same tap logic) and refreshes from prefs.. Inputs: tile tap. Outputs: startForegroundService intent; tile state update. Dependencies: OverlayService; SharedPreferences store. Evidence: RecordTileService.kt: onClick; RecordTileService.kt: refresh; AndroidManifest.xml: BIND_QUICK_SETTINGS_TILE service declaration. Source: app/src/main/java/com/promptly/mobile/RecordTileService.kt
